newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan stocks fall 2.05 pct before close.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan stocks fall 2.05 pct before close.

text.p: Heavy profit-taking erased early gains in Taiwan's stock market shortly before close on Tuesday as investors' sentiment turned cautious with the index near the 10,000-point resistance level, brokers said.
With 30 minutes left at 0330 GMT, the index was down 202.04 points or 2.05 percent at 9,631.73, off an intraday high 9,877.39.
Turnover was heavy at T$ 155.1 billion.
